title: Prescribed pullback on rational stage inclusions and integral localization
statement: Fix a prime l, schemes X,Y with l invertible, any morphism g:X→Y and a finite coefficient field E in the fixed algebraic closure. Inclusion of the E-stage followed by the specified common-stage pullback equals the specified rational E-pullback followed by inclusion on X. Integral localization followed by rational pullback equals constructible integral pullback followed by integral localization. If g is an isomorphism, the prescribed completion-unit comparison restricts to a natural isomorphism on integral constructible inputs, with its specified inverse components.

lean.statement:
theorem realizationPullback_inclusion_eq (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] (E : Index l (PadicAlgCl l)) :
    inclusion (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := Y) E ⋙
        commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g =
      rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) g ⋙
        inclusion (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E
